title: Migrate ~/.claude/knowledge from v0.1 layout to v0.2 concepts.jsonl
body:
## Problem

The live knowledge base at `~/.claude/knowledge` is still in the v0.1 layout (`concepts/*.md` with YAML front matter, `config.json`, `index.json`). The v0.2 `kt` only reads `concepts.jsonl`, so every command fails with `kt: no knowledge base ... (run kt init)`.

It holds 2 concepts: `graph-neural-networks` and `message-passing`, both level 2, tag `gnn`, created 2026-10-26.

## Mapping v0.1 -> v0.2

- `title` -> `name`; `kind`, `created`, `last_evidenced` dropped
- `evidence` list -> `note` (v0.2 needs a note at level >= 1)
- `part-of` is gone in v0.2; `message-passing` part-of `graph-neural-networks` becomes a tag or a `requires` link
- levels: v0.1 was 0-4 (unknown/aware/explain/apply/connect), v0.2 is 0-3 (unknown/heard-of/understands/can-use). 0-2 map directly; 3 and 4 both become 3
- keep the existing `.git` history; commit the rewrite as one `kt:` commit

Decide whether this is a one-off by hand or a `kt migrate` command.
